name: goal-mode
description: Lets Claude set its own session goal; an independent evaluator keeps it working at Stop until the goal is met (defers to native ProposeGoal when available).

autoGoal.title: Auto-declare goals
autoGoal.description: Nudge the model to set a goal when a prompt asks for an outcome (a request verb, not a question) and when a plan is approved

nativeGoal.title: Use Claude Code's /goal
nativeGoal.description: Hand goals (set_goal, /goal-mode set|auto) to the built-in /goal where this build has it, so they show and are judged as the person's own /goal; off keeps this plugin's own evaluator
